description: What a giant impact has left (3D runs with gravity, e.g. moon-forming-impact): the gas sorted by the Kepler orbit each cell is on about the densest body into the planet (pericenter inside it), the disk around it and what escapes, with each part’s mass, the share of it that is each species and the mean dye, the disk’s angular momentum, and the mass of the moon the disk would gather into. For 3D runs with gravity (the moon-forming-impact preset). Masses in code units (Earth masses in that preset); shares are mass fractions by species, and the mean dye, which tells the two bodies apart.
name: impact
